name: Homes below dot, config and state ancestors publish local mate and MAIN briefs through real or aliased home paths
A remote mate in a hidden home publishes exact UTF-8 brief bytes inline and refuses a hidden brief without appending
Public cross-home symlinks work in both directions for publication, path resolution, encoding and snapshot staging
Private literal symlinks into the other approved home are refused in both directions through configured aliases and resolved roots
Dotfiles, hidden directories, config and state below the home are refused directly and via public symlinks
Outside literal aliases, escapes to another mate, unapproved directories, traversal and relative paths cannot publish or stage a brief
